h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Guwahati

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Guwahati

items.pText: Guwahati is the largest city in the Northeast and the gateway to the region, spread between the Brahmaputra and a ring of green hills. Schools, housing societies, hotels and government campuses here order playground equipment from us. FunPlay Systems makes it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,070 km away, and sends each order to Assam by road.

With a delivery this long, the worst outcome is a truck reaching a site that is not ready. Before we dispatch, we confirm with you that the ground is cleared, the foundation points are marked and a vehicle can reach the gate. Guwahati gets heavy rain for a large part of the year, so plan the civil work for a drier spell. Our installation team or a dealer in the Northeast then installs the equipment as per the approved layout.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Getting your site ready before the equipment arrives

items: Clear and level the play area, and cut back any branches that hang over it.
Finish the drainage and any raised base before the equipment reaches you.
Check that a truck can reach the site, or decide where the parts will be unloaded and carried in.
Keep a covered, dry place ready to store the packed parts until installation.

facts.value: About 2,070 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What should we prepare before the equipment reaches Guwahati?
items.a: A cleared, level site with drainage in place, a route for the truck and a dry place to store the packed parts. We go through these points with you before the order is dispatched.

items.q: Can installation happen during the monsoon?
items.a: It can, but heavy rain slows foundation work and fresh concrete needs time to set. Where possible, plan grouting for a drier spell and keep the parts stored under cover until then.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Guwahati?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road, and our installation team or a dealer who serves the Northeast installs the equipment according to the layout you approved.
